welcome: Welcome to KisanVaani — a farming friend you can talk to. You don’t need to know anything about technology. Just speak in your language, and KisanVaani will help you. To use the voice assistant, simply open the app and click on the option called "Ask KisaanVaani" on the dashboard. Want to know today’s mandi price? How will the weather be? What to spray on your crops? Just press the mic and ask. The app will listen and give you the right answer in simple words. Even when the internet is slow or gone, some features still work. You can also save details about your animals, get reminders for tasks like watering or spraying, and learn about useful government schemes. KisaanVaani is always ready to help — in your voice, your language, and made just for you. You farm, it guides.

faq1_q: How do I select my language? Can I change it later?
faq1_a: When you first open KisaanVaani, you will be prompted to select your preferred language from a list. If you wish to change it later, you can easily do so from the 'Language' dropdown menu located in the settings section of your main dashboard.
faq2_q: What is the main "Ask KisaanVani" button for?
faq2_a:
The "Ask KisaanVani" voice assistant is the heart of the app, found in the center of your dashboard. While other icons take you to specific tools, you should use "Ask KisaanVani" for any complex or conversational question. Click it to:

- Ask for detailed, personalized advice (e.g., "What is the best way to deal with pests on my cotton crop?")
- Ask follow-up questions based on a previous answer
- Get help with any query that doesn't fit into a simple category
faq3_q: Does the app remember our past conversations?
faq3_a: Yes. Our AI has a conversational memory. For example, if you ask about fertilizer for wheat, you can then ask a follow-up question like, "What about for sugarcane?" and the assistant will understand the context without you having to repeat yourself.
faq5_q: How does the 'Government Schemes' feature work?
faq5_a: Tap the 'Govt Schemes' icon. Our AI will help you discover financial support you are eligible for. You can ask specific questions like, "What subsidies are available for dairy farmers in Gujarat?" and the app will give you details and direct links to the official government portals to apply.
faq6_q: How do I get a weather forecast for my farm?
faq6_a: Tap the 'Weather' icon. It will automatically show the detailed forecast for your current location, including temperature and rainfall predictions. You can also use the "Ask KisaanVani" voice assistant for specific queries like, "Will it rain in my village tomorrow evening?"
faq7_q: How can I get advice on a specific farming problem?
faq7_a:
You have two great options:

- Tap the 'Crop Advisory' icon for expert-backed information on seeds, nutrition, and more.
- For a more specific problem, use the "Ask KisaanVani" voice assistant. For instance, ask "What are the signs of yellow rust disease in wheat?" and our AI will provide a quick diagnosis and solution.

This is a powerful platform to connect with others. Tap the 'Community' icon to:

- Share your knowledge and get advice from other experienced farmers.
- Most importantly, connect directly with verified buyers and vendors, helping you to cut out middlemen and increase your profits.
faq9_q: How do the 'Livestock' and 'Farm Database' features work?
faq9_a: These are your digital record-keeping tools. Tap on 'Livestock Database' to add, track, and manage all important information about your animals, like health records, breed, and age. This helps you keep everything organized in one safe place on your phone.
faq10_a: The 'Reminders' feature helps you manage your farming schedule. You can set up alerts for important activities like irrigation, sowing dates, fertilizing, and harvesting, ensuring you never miss a critical step in your crop cycle.
